title: Reply with Template option missing
creator: rousea
content:
I want to configure an automatic response to emails that have been forwarded to me from a particular address. I have created a template for the response and it is saved in the Templates folder. I then attempted to create a Filter Rule to send the response. I believe there should be a Reply with Template option in the Perform these action pull-down, but there isn't. I've attached a screen shot to illustrate this.

I'm using Thunderbird 154.0 and Windows 11. Is there a new way of achieving my objective?

title: The client stopped seeing the folder.
creator: ap4mobile
content: Hello! I don't understand what's happening with the folders... I've been using Mozilla Thunderbird with this setup for a long time. I had a RedMine folder and a filter configured to move messages from the Inbox to it. But recently, the filter stopped working because it couldn't find the folder on the server, even though I could see it in the folder tree and in the web version of Mail. I deleted the folder and created it again. I enabled the filter, and the messages moved, but they weren't moved to the new folder, but to the one in the Trash, and the new one remained empty. Yes, I restarted Thunderbird, and messages started moving to the new folder, but I don't understand why this happened in the first place—why did I have to delete and recreate the folder?
